name: PackageSliderCard
job: A single slider with named stops that sets one package card (name, price, included items) as the visitor drags between tiers; the price is an odometer that rolls to the new value
visitor_action: drag the thumb or press arrow keys; tap a stop label
owner_settings: Packages (name, price, short tagline, included items one per line)
mobile: slider above card, thumb snaps to stops
motion: thumb snaps with spring, price digits roll as 3D drums (units fastest), included items check in one by one (reduced-motion: instant swap, no roll)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: worst-case stop labels showed a clipped third line)

art_direction: Swiss paper #f2f1ed and ink #111110 with vermilion #e2411c accents, Inter Tight only. One big move: ticker lockup, ten-face 3D drums set straight on the paper (no well), 0.52em pitch, raised superscript currency flush to the first drum, price note on the digit baseline; depth shown by top/bottom edge fade only. Hairline slider with square stops and ruled rows.
